title: Node.js Runtime Environment

content.explanation: Originally JavaScript could only run inside browsers. Node.js changed this by embedding the V8 engine into a server-side runtime environment. It provides APIs for file systems, networking, processes, and operating system interactions. This allows developers to use JavaScript for backend applications, automation, and command-line tools.
content.example: Node.js can create files on disk using the file system module.
content.analogy: A car engine installed in a different vehicle can perform new jobs beyond its original purpose.
content.keyTakeaway: Node.js enables JavaScript to run outside the browser.

revisionSummary: Node.js runs JavaScript on operating systems.
